'''Zoran Velfahsa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on the [[Eternal Empire]] capital of [[Zakuul]]. He was a member of the [[Heralds of Zildrog]], a cult worshipping the mythical serpent-god [[Zildrog]] that controlled the [[Old World]] of Zakuul. In [[3631 BBY]] he was present during the meeting between the leader of the Heralds [[the Exalted]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], wanted for the assassination of Emperor [[Valkorion]]. When the Exalted departed to meet with the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]], he ordered Zoran and two other Heralds to kill the Outlander and their companion. However, the Heralds were defeated and all three perished during the fight.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zoran Velfahsa appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 7: The Lady of Sorrows'''.
